title: Money & possessions (B1)
note: V_MON-B1B2-01 · B1 money layer above leaf_shopping_a1/a2 · spending & owing, charges & banking, possessions & attitudes · every word new against the pool at this position · carriers via use[] · picture-led intro + 19-sentence Use bank added 2026-08-10 (cloud lane C)

intro.title: Money in, money out, money owed
intro.body: Thirty-six words in three layers: what you spend and what you owe, what the bank and the state charge you, and what you own — with the words English uses for people who are careful or careless with money.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: spend takes on, never for: I spend a lot of money on books. English spends time the same way — I spend every evening at home.

sentences.en: My parents can't afford a new car because they are paying for my studies.
sentences.cz: Rodiče si nemůžou dovolit nové auto, protože platí moje studium.
accepts: My parents can't afford a new car because they are paying for my studies
My parents cannot afford a new car because they are paying for my studies

sentences.en: I spend too much money on coffee, but I never buy lunch at work.
sentences.cz: Za kávu utrácím moc peněz, ale oběd v práci si nikdy nekupuju.
accepts: I spend too much money on coffee, but I never buy lunch at work

sentences.en: My brother owes me a lot of money, which he promised to pay in June.
sentences.cz: Bratr mi dluží hodně peněz, které slíbil zaplatit v červnu.
accepts: My brother owes me a lot of money, which he promised to pay in June

sentences.en: This debt is a big problem for our family because my father lost his job.
sentences.cz: Tenhle dluh je pro naši rodinu velký problém, protože otec přišel o práci.
accepts: This debt is a big problem for our family because my father lost his job

sentences.en: My savings are in a new account which my sister opened for me.
sentences.cz: Moje úspory jsou na novém účtu, který mi založila sestra.
accepts: My savings are in a new account which my sister opened for me

sentences.en: Our budget does not cover all the expenses, so we must wait one more year.
sentences.cz: Náš rozpočet nepokrývá všechny výdaje, takže musíme počkat ještě rok.
accepts: Our budget does not cover all the expenses, so we must wait one more year
Our budget doesn't cover all the expenses, so we must wait one more year

sentences.en: The bank charges a small fee when you send money abroad.
sentences.cz: Banka si účtuje malý poplatek, když posíláš peníze do zahraničí.
accepts: The bank charges a small fee when you send money abroad

sentences.en: We need to pay a deposit before we get the keys.
sentences.cz: Musíme zaplatit zálohu, než dostaneme klíče.
accepts: We need to pay a deposit before we get the keys

sentences.en: My father pays higher taxes than he did five years ago.
sentences.cz: Otec platí vyšší daně než před pěti lety.
accepts: My father pays higher taxes than he did five years ago

sentences.en: Travel insurance is cheap, but nobody reads what it covers.
sentences.cz: Cestovní pojištění je levné, ale nikdo nečte, co pokrývá.
accepts: Travel insurance is cheap, but nobody reads what it covers

sentences.en: My sister has a mortgage on her flat which she will pay for twenty years.
sentences.cz: Sestra má na byt hypotéku, kterou bude splácet dvacet let.
accepts: My sister has a mortgage on her flat which she will pay for twenty years

sentences.en: I want to exchange my money for a different currency before we fly to London.
sentences.cz: Chci si vyměnit peníze za jinou měnu, než poletíme do Londýna.
accepts: I want to exchange my money for a different currency before we fly to London

sentences.en: The company made a profit last year, not a loss.
sentences.cz: Ta firma měla loni zisk, ne ztrátu.
accepts: The company made a profit last year, not a loss
The company made a profit last year not a loss

sentences.en: This flat is my father's property, but my brother lives in it.
sentences.cz: Tenhle byt je majetek mého otce, ale bydlí v něm můj bratr.
accepts: This flat is my father's property, but my brother lives in it

sentences.en: Please take your belongings with you when you leave the train.
sentences.cz: Až budete vystupovat z vlaku, vezměte si prosím své věci s sebou.
accepts: Please take your belongings with you when you leave the train

sentences.en: A car is not a luxury here, because the buses stop at six.
sentences.cz: Auto tady není luxus, protože autobusy končí v šest.
accepts: A car is not a luxury here, because the buses stop at six

sentences.en: My grandmother is more generous than the rest of the family.
sentences.cz: Moje babička je štědřejší než zbytek rodiny.
accepts: My grandmother is more generous than the rest of the family

sentences.en: We want to donate money to the school where my children study.
sentences.cz: Chceme darovat peníze škole, kde studují moje děti.
accepts: We want to donate money to the school where my children study

sentences.en: This phone has a two-year guarantee, but I lost the paper from the shop.
sentences.cz: Tenhle telefon má dvouletou záruku, ale ztratil jsem papír z obchodu.
accepts: This phone has a two-year guarantee, but I lost the paper from the shop
